caption:
Most electricians know how busy they were last month.

Very few know these 3 numbers 👇

1️⃣ Cost per booked job
2️⃣ Estimate close rate
3️⃣ Repeat + referral rate

If you don't know the second one, you're probably driving across town to write free quotes. If you don't know the third, you're paying again for customers you already earned.

Score yourself honestly. 0, 1, 2 or 3?

Want the sheet that calculates all 3 from last month's numbers?
Comment NUMBERS and I'll DM it to you.
